newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca shares lead UK drugs sector lower.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca shares lead UK drugs sector lower.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Plc dragged the British pharmaceuticals sector lower on Tuesday as a renewed bout of sterling strength reawakened concerns that profits could be further hit by the exchange rate, dealers said.
By 1010 GMT, Zeneca shares were 35p weaker at 17.525 stg. SmithKline Beecham was down 15p at 877-1/2 and Glaxo slipped twp pence to 991-1/2.

"All the drugs stocks are weak," one market-maker said. "Sterling was very strong overnight, and some people who were betting on sterling retreating will have to reconsider. That will hit foreign earners again."
